desks.headline: Cherag's Rayan could decide top spot as Haaland waits
desks.text: Forest lead Man City 2-0 with 29 minutes gone, and Haaland has **just 1 point** with 21 managers waiting on his armband. Cherag sits top on 664 with **Rayan** still to play, the only one of you who owns him, while Ayodele is 9 back and needs Haaland to fire. Hishaan's Barry has already hauled 32 points for Hishaan alone, and Edd and Hishaan are joint 7th with Omar just above them.

desks.headline: Rayan could decide top spot while Haaland waits on 1 point
desks.text: Haaland has **1 point** with 21 managers waiting on his armband, and Cherag sits top on 664. Only Cherag owns **Rayan** still to play, and he's **9 clear** of Ayodele, who needs Gomez and Gakpo to rescue him.

desks.headline: Cherki bites benchers as Cherag's Rayan eyes top spot
desks.text: Cherki has scored for **9 points** in NFO v MCI, while Nihal, Nanik and Dominic sit on the bench, and Elvin's armband is worth **18 points** to him. Cherag leads Ayodele by **8** at the top, with Rayan still to come for Cherag alone. Haaland's armband, shared by 21 managers, is the bigger question still to be answered.

desks.headline: Haaland blanks as 21 armbands go up in smoke
desks.text: Haaland blanked for **4 points** and **21 armbands went to waste**, so the 8 who went elsewhere just gained ground. Cherag still leads Ayodele by **8**, but Rayan is still to play for Cherag alone and could decide top spot if he fires.

desks.headline: Rayan could decide top spot as Cherag leads by 8
desks.text: Cherag leads Ayodele by **8** at the top, with **Rayan** still to play for Cherag alone, so one fixture could settle top spot. Ayodele needs **Gomez and Gakpo**, both still to play and both his alone, to haul himself back.

desks.headline: Rayan could settle top spot for Cherag
desks.text: Cherag still leads top spot by **8** over Ayodele, and Rayan, his captain, is still to play for him alone. Ayodele needs **Tavernier, Gomez and Gakpo**, all still to play and all his alone, to haul himself back. One result could settle it within about 2 hours.

desks.headline: Cherag's top spot hangs on Rayan's late fixture
desks.text: Cherag leads Ayodele by **8** at the top, with **Rayan** still to play for him alone, so one fixture could settle top spot. Ayodele needs Tavernier, Gomez and Gakpo, all his alone, to claw back. Haaland's blank has already wasted **21 armbands**, so the chase is wide open.

desks.headline: Rayan could settle top spot for Cherag tonight
desks.text: Cherag leads Ayodele by **8** at the top, and **Rayan**, his captain, is still to play for him alone, so one fixture could settle it. Ayodele's Haaland has already had his game, so he needs **Tavernier, Gomez and Gakpo**, all still to play and all his alone, to claw back.

desks.headline: Cherag and Ayodele fight for top spot as Rayan's fixture looms
desks.text: Top spot is still open: **Cherag leads Ayodele by 8**, with his captain **Rayan** still to play for him alone. Ayodele's Haaland has already returned just 4 points, so he needs **Tavernier, Gomez and Gakpo**, all yet to play, to claw back.

desks.headline: Evanilson scores and Raushan's lone captain pays off
desks.text: Evanilson has scored for IPS v BOU, and **Raushan** is the big winner, as his only captain he is collecting **10 captain points**. 13 managers started him, so **5 points** rattle the table, and Omar, one of 3 who bought him this week, cheers too.

desks.headline: Ayodele takes top spot as Gomez scores for him alone
desks.text: Ayodele takes top spot as **Gomez scores** for him alone, a differential haul that lifts him **8 clear of Cherag**. Rayan is still to play for Cherag, so one fixture could still narrow the gap. Ayodele's Haaland has already had his game, so the fight for the summit is now about Cherag's captain.

desks.headline: Ayodele holds top spot as Rayan plays for Cherag
desks.text: Top spot is still open, with **Ayodele 8 clear of Cherag**, whose captain Rayan is playing now. Ayodele's Haaland has already done his job, and Cherag still has 2 players to come, with Mbeumo among them. **Rayan's haul** will decide whether Cherag can close the gap before the summit settles.

desks.headline: Cherag's benched Groß scores as top spot tightens
desks.text: Cherag's bench call on **Groß** is haunting him, as the BHA v BRE man scores and collects **9 points** for those who started him. Cherag is **5 behind Ayodele** at the top, with Rayan still playing and Mbeumo still to come when MUN v AVL kicks off.

desks.headline: Sasha's Wirtz strike lands alone as captain Thiago blanks
desks.text: Sasha's lone **Wirtz** strike is the differential of the day, worth **8 points** while nobody else in the league gets a sniff. Ravi and Isaiah are celebrating Barcola's assist in CRY v LIV, but Sasha's captain Thiago is on **-2** in BHA v BRE.

desks.headline: Cherag's benched Groß scores as top spot tightens
desks.text: Cherag's benched Groß has scored, collecting **10 points** as BHA v BRE leads 2-0. Ayodele holds top spot on 688, **9 clear** of Cherag, whose Rayan is playing now. Mbeumo, the only player Cherag still has to come, could decide whether MUN v AVL closes that gap.

desks.headline: Sasha's lone Wirtz assist lands as Thiago blanks
desks.text: Sasha's **Wirtz** assist is worth **13 points**, and he is the only one in the league collecting them. Sasha's captain Thiago has blanked in BHA v BRE, so that Wirtz return is doing the heavy lifting. Saurabh's captain Isak, who scored in CRY v LIV, is paying off too.

desks.headline: Ayodele's top spot lead rests on MUN v AVL
desks.text: **Ayodele** leads on **689**, **10 clear** of Cherag, with one player still to come against Cherag's 2. Mbeumo is the one player Cherag alone still has to come, so when MUN v AVL kicks off the top spot could tighten.

desks.headline: Ayodele's top spot lead on the line as Mbeumo plays
desks.text: Ayodele leads on **690**, but Cherag sits **9 behind** with Rayan returning just 4 points, and MUN v AVL is live with Mbeumo on the pitch after Ayodele and Omar benched him. If Mbeumo starts firing, the top spot could tighten, so the lead is not yet settled.

desks.headline: N.Jackson scores as Ayodele's top spot lead holds
desks.text: **N.Jackson** has scored for Manchester United, delighting the 17 managers who started him. Ayodele holds top spot, **9 clear** of Cherag, whose captain Rayan has managed just 4 points. If Mbeumo, benched by Ayodele and Omar, starts firing, that lead could tighten.

desks.headline: Tonna's lone Fernandes goal rocks MUN v AVL
desks.text: **B.Fernandes** has scored for Manchester United, and only Tonna owns that **6 points**. Ayodele still leads on **696**, with Cherag **9 behind**, whose captain Rayan has 4 points. Cherag could close in if MUN v AVL keeps firing.

desks.headline: Ayodele holds top spot as Cherag's Rayan flops
desks.text: Ayodele sits on top with **694 points**, **9 clear** of Cherag, whose armband Rayan has managed just 4 points. MUN v AVL is live at 2-3, with B.Fernandes's goal owned only by Tonna, and Cherag could close in if benched Mbeumo, dropped by Ayodele and Omar, starts firing.

desks.headline: N.Jackson's assist keeps Ayodele on top, Cherag 8 back
desks.text: N.Jackson has set one up as Manchester United lead Aston Villa 2-4 with 64 minutes played, and his **11 points** land in 17 managers' teams. That keeps **Ayodele** on top on **700**, with Cherag **8 behind** on 692 and his Rayan captaincy managing just 4 points.

desks.headline: Fernandes's lone assist lifts Tonna as Ayodele holds top
desks.text: **B.Fernandes's** assist is the gameweek's sharpest knife, and only Tonna owns it, so his climb to 6th is all his. **Ayodele** still tops the table, with Cherag hunting him after Rayan's armband flopped. We said N.Jackson's haul could let **Bhavik** pass Ravi, and it did.

desks.headline: Dominic wins the week on 75 as Ayodele holds top spot
desks.text: **Dominic** won the week with **75**, the best score of the gameweek, while **Ayodele** still tops the table on 700, 8 clear of Cherag. Haaland blanked for 21 managers, and Hishaan's **Barry** armband hauled 32 to lift him 5 places to 9th. We said N.Jackson's haul could let Bhavik pass Ravi, and it did.

lines.text: If Gakpo hauls, Ayodele could take top spot from Cherag.
If N.Jackson hauls, Bhavik could pass Ravi.
If Evanilson hauls, Raushan could pass Simon.
If Rogers blanks, Tonna could pass Omar.
If Tavernier hauls, Nanik could finish in the Gold spots ahead of Sid. If he blanks, it's the other way round.
If Isak hauls, Saurabh could finish clear of the Tin Pot spots and Isaiah could drop in. If he blanks, it's the other way round.
